claims.statement: For an exact rank-two original-coordinate cross block C with one active bank consisting of exactly two physical coordinates, arbitrary same-bank quadratic-affine terms and outside conditioning are retained and ||p_Q||_3 <= 3^(2/3)e^(1/3)[det(CC^T)]^(-1/6).

If a post-Schur physical cross block contains a 2x2 minor D with |det D|>=delta L^2 and the scalar coefficient satisfies |a|>=tau L, then arbitrary residual cross rank and same-bank curvature obey ||p_Q||_infinity <36.45 tau^(-1/2)delta^(-1/4)L^(-1); in exact cross rank two the grouped constant improves to 7.251 tau^(-1/2)delta^(-1/4)L^(-1).

For outer coefficient a=epsilon L and pre-Schur core L diag(R,R^-1), the exact post-Schur core determinant is L^2[1-epsilon(u1v1/(L^2R)+R u2v2/L^2)]. For any theta in (0,1), either its determinant has modulus >=theta L^2 and the E2/grouped receiver pays, or some physical arm i satisfies |u_i v_i|>[(1-theta)/2]L|h_i|. At theta=1/2 the paid constants are <43.34/L in arbitrary residual rank and <8.622/L in exact rank two.

For the exact post-Schur cross block M, if its top-three truncation has s3>=rho L, row range leverage<=1/2, and s4<=s3/16, the c2414 volume-stability theorem gives a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity<23/(rho L).

designated_partner_application.actual_inequality: For Q_(R,L)=L X0^2+2LR U1V1+2L/R U2V2, ||p||_infinity<7.251/L; the grouped exact-rank-two theorem extends the same scale to arbitrary same-bank quadratic-affine curvature with constant 7.2500551089/L.
